items.title: Western Union Yields 13.5%. Is This Dividend Stock a Trap?
items.summary: The payout hasn't moved in years, yet the yield keeps climbing because investors keep dumping the stock. We tested three high-yield names on earnings, cash flow, and debt, and one of them is paying dividends from reserves.

items.title: How Much Passive Income $800,000 in Edison, International Paper, Altria and AT&T Pays Each Year
items.summary: One of these four high-yield dividend payers earns less than it hands out, while another faces a wildfire liability nobody can price. Before you build a retirement paycheck around them, find out which stocks carry the real risk.

items.title: Is Wall Street Bullish or Bearish on International Paper Stock?
items.summary: International Paper has underperformed the broader market over the past year, but analysts are highly optimistic about the stock’s prospects.

items.title: DOJ subpoenas Smurfit Westrock, IP, PCA, Cascades over containerboard pricing
items.summary: The action is related to a grand jury investigation, the companies disclosed this week. They’re also still defendants in an ongoing class-action price-fixing lawsuit.

items.title: DS Smith details ‘transformation’ prior to spinning off from IP
items.summary: Site closures, job cuts and strategy resets have helped productivity in the more than 18 months since being acquired by International Paper, executives said. The company split is still slated for the coming months.

items.title: ETFs Are Net Sellers of International Paper (IP) on Monday
items.summary: ETFs sold a net $11.2 million of International Paper on Monday, with 19 funds cutting and 28 adding.

items.title: Is International Paper (IP) Below Fair Value After Its 20% Gain?
items.summary: International Paper has delivered a 20.0% gain over the past 3 years, while recent headlines and shifting expectations around its packaging businesses keep the story in motion. With the share price at US$36.37 after mixed shorter term returns, the question now is whether that tag is well supported by what the company is generating through its sales. A 20.0% return over 3 years puts real weight on the idea that International Paper's revenue base can justify a meaningfully higher valuation...
